conviction.explanation: Consensus-capped research conviction for the buy thesis, not a probability or backtested expected return. I retain the research-manager ruling: Core profit growth of 32.6%, positive FCF and a single-digit quoted multiple give the bull concrete support beyond a dividend narrative. Thin margins temper conviction but do not erase the normalized core improvement already reported. Positive operating evidence and the longer trend support modest directional conviction, tempered by near-term momentum and data limitations. Conviction has been capped by deterministic analyst consensus; convergence has been computed from the four reports.
